sections.title: Options — Grid Multi Pick
sections.summary: The answer choices visitors pick from — selection mode, list-or-grid layout, item states, spacing, and styling. This guide covers every Options setting that applies to a Grid Multi Pick screen — a two-column grid. Each setting matches a real control in the screen editor.

sections.title: List or grid
sections.summary: Two columns — the options are laid out as a grid of cards, two per row.

sections.title: Available item layouts
sections.summary: This screen offers these item layouts (set under “Item layout” below):  Title  •  Title + Subtitle  •  Small Image + Title  •  Medium Image + Title  •  Big Image + Title  •  Full Image.

sections.title: How visitors choose
sections.summary: Multi select — visitors can choose several options (up to the “Max selections” limit) before tapping the button to continue.

sections.title: Switchable
sections.summary: Selection mode and column layout are fixed for this screen type — they are part of what makes it this kind of screen.

sections.title: How this screen works
sections.summary: How this screen works

sections.title: Options in the editor
sections.summary: Options in the editor

sections.title: Context caption
sections.summary: Open the Options section in the screen editor to configure its settings.

sections.title: Grid cell proportions
sections.summary: Sets each grid cell's height as a percentage of its width: 100 is square, above 100 makes taller cells, below 100 makes wider, shorter cells. Pick taller cells for image-led options and square for balanced icon-and-text choices. Only appears on two-column grids — try 100 first, then adjust to fit your content.

sections.title: Grid cell proportions
sections.summary: Grid cell proportions

sections.title: Checkbox placement in grid cells
sections.summary: On grid cells, show or hide the selection checkbox and place it in a corner (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, or bottom-right) with an optional offset. Keep it visible on multi-select grids so visitors can see what they've picked; top-right is a common, unobtrusive spot. Only appears on grid layouts.

sections.title: Checkbox placement in grid cells
sections.summary: Checkbox placement in grid cells

sections.title: • Margin
sections.summary: Gap between the checkbox and the cell edges (top, right, bottom, left).

sections.title: • Position
sections.summary: Which corner of the cell the checkbox sits in (top-start, top-end, bottom-start, bottom-end).

sections.title: • Show checkbox
sections.summary: Turn the selection checkbox/marker on or off for grid cells.

sections.title: Checkbox look
sections.summary: Appearance of the selection checkbox — shape (square or circle), checked color, unchecked color, and padding. Use your theme's accent for the checked color so a tap reads clearly as selected, matching the selected-item look. Circle suits pick-one (radio style), square suits multi-select. Only appears when the layout includes a checkbox or on grids.

sections.title: Checkbox look
sections.summary: Checkbox look

sections.title: • Checkbox padding
sections.summary: Space around the selection marker.

sections.title: • Checked color
sections.summary: Color of the marker when the option is selected.

sections.title: • Shape
sections.summary: The selection-marker shape (square or circle).

sections.title: • Unchecked color
sections.summary: Color of the marker when the option is not selected.

sections.title: Image area in each card
sections.summary: On grid cards that show an image, this sets the image region as a whole: where it sits in the card, how tall it is (a fixed height or sized to fit its content), and the spacing around it. By default it fits the content, but setting one fixed height keeps every card's image lined up at the same level, which looks more polished and trustworthy on an ad landing page. This shapes the image's container only; the image's own size and corners are set separately in the item image styles.

sections.title: Image area in each card
sections.summary: Image area in each card

sections.title: • Content align
sections.summary: Horizontal alignment of the image inside the region.

sections.title: • Height mode
sections.summary: How the image region is sized: a fixed pixel height, a percent of the cell, or auto.

sections.title: • Height value
sections.summary: The height number used by the chosen mode (px or %).

sections.title: • Region padding
sections.summary: Empty space inside the image region around the image (top, right, bottom, left).

sections.title: • Vertical align
sections.summary: Where the image sits within its region — top, center, or bottom.

sections.title: Item image look
sections.summary: Size and look of each item's image — width, height, corner radius, padding, and how it fits its box (fit shows the whole image with possible empty space; fill crops to cover the box). Keep a consistent size and small radius so cards look uniform; choose fill for photos and fit for logos or icons you don't want cropped. Only appears when the layout includes an image.

sections.title: Item image look
sections.summary: Item image look

sections.title: • Corner radius
sections.summary: How rounded the image corners are.

sections.title: • Image height
sections.summary: Height (px) of the option's image or icon.

sections.title: • Image padding
sections.summary: Space around the image inside the option.

sections.title: • Image width
sections.summary: Width (px) of the option's image or icon.

sections.title: • Scale mode
sections.summary: How the image fills its box (fit, fill, or stretch).

sections.title: Shuffle item order
sections.summary: When enabled, randomizes the order items appear to users on each view. Useful for A/B testing, survey randomization, and reducing position bias in multi-select scenarios.

sections.title: Shuffle item order
sections.summary: Shuffle item order

sections.title: What each choice shows
sections.summary: Pick which parts each choice displays — title only, image plus title, checkbox with title and subtitle, and so on; available combos depend on your selection mode and layout. Adding an element reveals its style controls and means you must supply that content (image or subtitle) on every item. Default to title (plus a checkbox for multi-select) and add an image only when it aids the choice.

sections.title: What each choice shows
sections.summary: What each choice shows

sections.title: Padding inside each item
sections.summary: The space between each item's edge and its content (title, image, checkbox), set per side — top, end, bottom, start. More padding makes items feel roomy and easier to tap; too little looks cramped. Around 12–16px on all sides reads well on mobile, and the setting applies to every item.

sections.title: Padding inside each item
sections.summary: Padding inside each item

sections.title: Gap between choices
sections.summary: The spacing between adjacent choices — a vertical gap in lists, the gap between cells in grids. Around 8–12px keeps items clearly separate and easy to tap without wasting space. Increase it for a more airy feel, or decrease it to fit more options above the fold.

sections.title: Gap between choices
sections.summary: Gap between choices

sections.title: Margin around the whole list
sections.summary: The outer space between the screen edges and the first and last items, set per side (top, end, bottom, start). Use it to keep the list off the screen edges and aligned with your other sections. This is the outside spacing — for the gap inside each item use Padding inside each item instead.

sections.title: Margin around the whole list
sections.summary: Margin around the whole list

sections.title: Cap on multi-select picks
sections.summary: Limits how many items a visitor can choose on a multi-select screen. Set a small cap (e.g. 3) to keep answers focused and the next step manageable; leave it unlimited to let them pick freely. This control only appears on multi-select screens and is ignored everywhere else.

sections.title: Cap on multi-select picks
sections.summary: Cap on multi-select picks

sections.title: Selected item look
sections.summary: How a choice looks once tapped — background, border, corner radius, and optional gradient. Make it clearly distinct from the unselected look (an accent border or filled background) so visitors get instant confirmation; weak feedback here causes hesitation and drop-off. Your theme's accent color is a reliable choice.

sections.title: Selected item look
sections.summary: Selected item look

sections.title: • Background color
sections.summary: The highlight fill behind the option the visitor HAS picked.

sections.title: • Border color
sections.summary: Outline color for the selected option — often your accent color.

sections.title: • Border width
sections.summary: Outline thickness for the selected option.

sections.title: • Corner radius
sections.summary: Corner rounding for the selected option; usually matches the unselected state.

sections.title: • Gradient fill
sections.summary: Optional gradient highlight for the selected option.

sections.title: Item subtitle text style
sections.summary: Typography for the item subtitle — size, weight, color, alignment, line height, optional background, and padding, applied to all items as a shared template. Keep the subtitle visually quieter than the title (smaller, muted color) so it reads as supporting text. Only appears when your item layout includes a subtitle.

sections.title: Item subtitle text style
sections.summary: Item subtitle text style

sections.title: • Background color
sections.summary: Fill drawn behind the subtitle.

sections.title: • Background opacity
sections.summary: Transparency of that subtitle background.

sections.title: • Background radius
sections.summary: Corner rounding of the subtitle background.

sections.title: • Font size
sections.summary: Text size (px) of each option's subtitle.

sections.title: • Font weight
sections.summary: How bold the subtitle is.

sections.title: • Line height
sections.summary: Spacing between subtitle lines.

sections.title: • Subtitle padding
sections.summary: Space around the subtitle text.

sections.title: • Text align
sections.summary: Alignment of the subtitle.

sections.title: • Text color
sections.summary: Subtitle color — usually a muted shade.

sections.title: Text area in each card
sections.summary: On grid cards with an image, this sets the title-and-subtitle region as a block: where it sits in the card, how tall it is (a fixed height or sized to fit its content), and the spacing around it. It fits the content by default, but choosing one fixed height keeps the text blocks aligned across every card so the row reads as a clean, scannable set. This controls the text region's position only; the actual fonts and colors of the title and subtitle are set in their own style sections.

sections.title: Text area in each card
sections.summary: Text area in each card

sections.title: • Content align
sections.summary: Horizontal alignment of the text inside the region.

sections.title: • Height mode
sections.summary: Fixed px, percent of the cell, or auto height for the text region.

sections.title: • Height value
sections.summary: The height number used by the chosen mode.

sections.title: • Region padding
sections.summary: Space inside the text region around the title and subtitle.

sections.title: • Vertical align
sections.summary: Where the title/subtitle block sits within its region.

sections.title: Item title text style
sections.summary: Typography for every item's title — size, weight, color, alignment, line height, plus an optional background chip (color, opacity, radius) and padding. It's a shared template, so an edit restyles all items at once. Leave it on theme defaults for consistency, adjusting size or color only to improve readability against the item background.

sections.title: Item title text style
sections.summary: Item title text style

sections.title: • Background color
sections.summary: Fill drawn behind the title text.

sections.title: • Background opacity
sections.summary: Transparency of that title background (0–100%).

sections.title: • Background radius
sections.summary: Corner rounding of the title background.

sections.title: • Font size
sections.summary: Text size (px) of each option's title.

sections.title: • Font weight
sections.summary: How bold the title is.

sections.title: • Line height
sections.summary: Vertical spacing between title lines.

sections.title: • Text align
sections.summary: Left, center, or right alignment of the title.

sections.title: • Text color
sections.summary: Title color.

sections.title: • Title padding
sections.summary: Space around the title text (top, right, bottom, left).

sections.title: Unselected item look
sections.summary: The default look of each choice before it's tapped — background, border, corner radius, and an optional gradient. Keep it neutral and calm so the selected state can stand out; the contrast between this and the selected look is what tells visitors their tap registered. Pair it with the Selected item look.

sections.title: Unselected item look
sections.summary: Unselected item look

sections.title: • Background color
sections.summary: The fill behind an option the visitor has NOT selected.

sections.title: • Border color
sections.summary: Color of that outline.

sections.title: • Border width
sections.summary: Thickness (px) of the outline around an unselected option; 0 hides it.

sections.title: • Corner radius
sections.summary: How rounded the option corners are (px); higher is softer.

sections.title: • Gradient fill
sections.summary: Optional gradient that replaces the flat background color for a richer look.

sections.title: Even grid cell heights
sections.summary: On a grid, choose whether all cells stretch to the same maximum height for tidy, even rows, or each cell sizes to its own content (giving rows of varying height). Turn it on for a clean, consistent grid; turn it off when items have very different content lengths. Only applies to grid layouts.

sections.title: Even grid cell heights
sections.summary: Even grid cell heights

sections.title: Vertical alignment of items
sections.summary: Aligns each choice's content to the top, center, or bottom of its cell. It's most noticeable in grid layouts where cells are taller than their content; center usually looks balanced. In simple lists it has little visible effect, so center is a safe default.

sections.title: Vertical alignment of items
sections.summary: Vertical alignment of items

translations.en: The answer choices visitors pick from — selection mode, list-or-grid layout, item states, spacing, and styling. This guide covers every Options setting that applies to a Grid Multi Pick screen — a two-column grid. Each setting matches a real control in the screen editor.
Multi select — visitors can choose several options (up to the “Max selections” limit) before tapping the button to continue.
Two columns — the options are laid out as a grid of cards, two per row.
Selection mode and column layout are fixed for this screen type — they are part of what makes it this kind of screen.
This screen offers these item layouts (set under “Item layout” below):  Title  •  Title + Subtitle  •  Small Image + Title  •  Medium Image + Title  •  Big Image + Title  •  Full Image.

en.name: The screen editor with the Options section highlighted.

translations.en: Open the Options section in the screen editor to configure its settings.
When enabled, randomizes the order items appear to users on each view. Useful for A/B testing, survey randomization, and reducing position bias in multi-select scenarios.

en.name: Where to find “Shuffle item order” in the editor.

nodes.label: Selection behaviour · Cap on multi-select picks

translations.en: Limits how many items a visitor can choose on a multi-select screen. Set a small cap (e.g. 3) to keep answers focused and the next step manageable; leave it unlimited to let them pick freely. This control only appears on multi-select screens and is ignored everywhere else.

en.name: Where to find “Cap on multi-select picks” in the editor.

nodes.label: List or grid layout · What each choice shows

translations.en: Pick which parts each choice displays — title only, image plus title, checkbox with title and subtitle, and so on; available combos depend on your selection mode and layout. Adding an element reveals its style controls and means you must supply that content (image or subtitle) on every item. Default to title (plus a checkbox for multi-select) and add an image only when it aids the choice.

en.name: Where to find “What each choice shows” in the editor.

nodes.label: List or grid layout · Vertical alignment of items

translations.en: Aligns each choice's content to the top, center, or bottom of its cell. It's most noticeable in grid layouts where cells are taller than their content; center usually looks balanced. In simple lists it has little visible effect, so center is a safe default.

en.name: Where to find “Vertical alignment of items” in the editor.

nodes.label: List or grid layout · Even grid cell heights

translations.en: On a grid, choose whether all cells stretch to the same maximum height for tidy, even rows, or each cell sizes to its own content (giving rows of varying height). Turn it on for a clean, consistent grid; turn it off when items have very different content lengths. Only applies to grid layouts.

en.name: Where to find “Even grid cell heights” in the editor.

nodes.label: List or grid layout · Grid cell proportions

translations.en: Sets each grid cell's height as a percentage of its width: 100 is square, above 100 makes taller cells, below 100 makes wider, shorter cells. Pick taller cells for image-led options and square for balanced icon-and-text choices. Only appears on two-column grids — try 100 first, then adjust to fit your content.

en.name: Where to find “Grid cell proportions” in the editor.

nodes.label: Selected & unselected look · Unselected item look

translations.en: The default look of each choice before it's tapped — background, border, corner radius, and an optional gradient. Keep it neutral and calm so the selected state can stand out; the contrast between this and the selected look is what tells visitors their tap registered. Pair it with the Selected item look.

en.name: Where to find “Unselected item look” in the editor.

translations.en: The fill behind an option the visitor has NOT selected.
Thickness (px) of the outline around an unselected option; 0 hides it.
How rounded the option corners are (px); higher is softer.
Optional gradient that replaces the flat background color for a richer look.

nodes.label: Selected & unselected look · Selected item look

translations.en: How a choice looks once tapped — background, border, corner radius, and optional gradient. Make it clearly distinct from the unselected look (an accent border or filled background) so visitors get instant confirmation; weak feedback here causes hesitation and drop-off. Your theme's accent color is a reliable choice.

en.name: Where to find “Selected item look” in the editor.

translations.en: The highlight fill behind the option the visitor HAS picked.
Outline thickness for the selected option.
Outline color for the selected option — often your accent color.
Corner rounding for the selected option; usually matches the unselected state.
Optional gradient highlight for the selected option.

nodes.label: Spacing & padding · Padding inside each item

translations.en: The space between each item's edge and its content (title, image, checkbox), set per side — top, end, bottom, start. More padding makes items feel roomy and easier to tap; too little looks cramped. Around 12–16px on all sides reads well on mobile, and the setting applies to every item.

en.name: Where to find “Padding inside each item” in the editor.

nodes.label: Spacing & padding · Margin around the whole list

translations.en: The outer space between the screen edges and the first and last items, set per side (top, end, bottom, start). Use it to keep the list off the screen edges and aligned with your other sections. This is the outside spacing — for the gap inside each item use Padding inside each item instead.

en.name: Where to find “Margin around the whole list” in the editor.

translations.en: The spacing between adjacent choices — a vertical gap in lists, the gap between cells in grids. Around 8–12px keeps items clearly separate and easy to tap without wasting space. Increase it for a more airy feel, or decrease it to fit more options above the fold.

en.name: Where to find “Gap between choices” in the editor.

nodes.label: Card regions (grid) · Image area in each card

translations.en: On grid cards that show an image, this sets the image region as a whole: where it sits in the card, how tall it is (a fixed height or sized to fit its content), and the spacing around it. By default it fits the content, but setting one fixed height keeps every card's image lined up at the same level, which looks more polished and trustworthy on an ad landing page. This shapes the image's container only; the image's own size and corners are set separately in the item image styles.

en.name: Where to find “Image area in each card” in the editor.

nodes.label: Image area in each card · Vertical align

translations.en: Where the image sits within its region — top, center, or bottom.

nodes.label: Image area in each card · Content align

translations.en: Horizontal alignment of the image inside the region.

nodes.label: Image area in each card · Height mode

translations.en: How the image region is sized: a fixed pixel height, a percent of the cell, or auto.

nodes.label: Image area in each card · Height value

translations.en: The height number used by the chosen mode (px or %).

nodes.label: Image area in each card · Region padding

translations.en: Empty space inside the image region around the image (top, right, bottom, left).

nodes.label: Card regions (grid) · Text area in each card

translations.en: On grid cards with an image, this sets the title-and-subtitle region as a block: where it sits in the card, how tall it is (a fixed height or sized to fit its content), and the spacing around it. It fits the content by default, but choosing one fixed height keeps the text blocks aligned across every card so the row reads as a clean, scannable set. This controls the text region's position only; the actual fonts and colors of the title and subtitle are set in their own style sections.

en.name: Where to find “Text area in each card” in the editor.

nodes.label: Text area in each card · Vertical align

translations.en: Where the title/subtitle block sits within its region.

nodes.label: Text area in each card · Content align

translations.en: Horizontal alignment of the text inside the region.

nodes.label: Text area in each card · Height mode

translations.en: Fixed px, percent of the cell, or auto height for the text region.

nodes.label: Text area in each card · Height value

translations.en: The height number used by the chosen mode.

nodes.label: Text area in each card · Region padding

translations.en: Space inside the text region around the title and subtitle.

nodes.label: Card regions (grid) · Checkbox placement in grid cells

translations.en: On grid cells, show or hide the selection checkbox and place it in a corner (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, or bottom-right) with an optional offset. Keep it visible on multi-select grids so visitors can see what they've picked; top-right is a common, unobtrusive spot. Only appears on grid layouts.

en.name: Where to find “Checkbox placement in grid cells” in the editor.

nodes.label: Checkbox placement in grid cells · Show checkbox

translations.en: Turn the selection checkbox/marker on or off for grid cells.

nodes.label: Checkbox placement in grid cells · Position

translations.en: Which corner of the cell the checkbox sits in (top-start, top-end, bottom-start, bottom-end).

nodes.label: Checkbox placement in grid cells · Margin

translations.en: Gap between the checkbox and the cell edges (top, right, bottom, left).

nodes.label: Text, image & checkbox styles · Item title text style

translations.en: Typography for every item's title — size, weight, color, alignment, line height, plus an optional background chip (color, opacity, radius) and padding. It's a shared template, so an edit restyles all items at once. Leave it on theme defaults for consistency, adjusting size or color only to improve readability against the item background.

en.name: Where to find “Item title text style” in the editor.

nodes.label: Item title text style · Font size

translations.en: Text size (px) of each option's title.

nodes.label: Item title text style · Font weight
Item title text style · Text color
Item title text style · Text align

translations.en: Left, center, or right alignment of the title.

nodes.label: Item title text style · Line height
Item title text style · Background color

translations.en: Fill drawn behind the title text.

nodes.label: Item title text style · Background opacity
Item title text style · Background radius

translations.en: Corner rounding of the title background.

nodes.label: Item title text style · Title padding

translations.en: Space around the title text (top, right, bottom, left).

nodes.label: Text, image & checkbox styles · Item subtitle text style

translations.en: Typography for the item subtitle — size, weight, color, alignment, line height, optional background, and padding, applied to all items as a shared template. Keep the subtitle visually quieter than the title (smaller, muted color) so it reads as supporting text. Only appears when your item layout includes a subtitle.

en.name: Where to find “Item subtitle text style” in the editor.

nodes.label: Item subtitle text style · Font size

translations.en: Text size (px) of each option's subtitle.

nodes.label: Item subtitle text style · Font weight
Item subtitle text style · Text color

translations.en: Subtitle color — usually a muted shade.

nodes.label: Item subtitle text style · Text align
Item subtitle text style · Line height
Item subtitle text style · Background color
Item subtitle text style · Background opacity
Item subtitle text style · Background radius

translations.en: Corner rounding of the subtitle background.

nodes.label: Item subtitle text style · Subtitle padding
Text, image & checkbox styles · Item image look

translations.en: Size and look of each item's image — width, height, corner radius, padding, and how it fits its box (fit shows the whole image with possible empty space; fill crops to cover the box). Keep a consistent size and small radius so cards look uniform; choose fill for photos and fit for logos or icons you don't want cropped. Only appears when the layout includes an image.

en.name: Where to find “Item image look” in the editor.

translations.en: Width (px) of the option's image or icon.
Height (px) of the option's image or icon.
How the image fills its box (fit, fill, or stretch).
How rounded the image corners are.
Space around the image inside the option.

nodes.label: Text, image & checkbox styles · Checkbox look

translations.en: Appearance of the selection checkbox — shape (square or circle), checked color, unchecked color, and padding. Use your theme's accent for the checked color so a tap reads clearly as selected, matching the selected-item look. Circle suits pick-one (radio style), square suits multi-select. Only appears when the layout includes a checkbox or on grids.

en.name: Where to find “Checkbox look” in the editor.

translations.en: Color of the marker when the option is selected.
Color of the marker when the option is not selected.
